Studied: Academics.description:
📚 You were a strong student: entrance exam prep, cram school and top grades in math, literature and history.

🌱 Lectures, papers and written exams come more easily to you than to most.
⚠️ Specialist academy work still takes effort, and book learning says little about people.
⚖️ Grades open doors but promise nothing, and a scholarship can be lost.
🏫 It shows in neat notes, a study schedule and classmates asking to borrow your notes.

📈 Grants: Academics +15
Studied: Academics.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has studied hard: mathematics, modern and classical Japanese, history, the habits of a good student and the stamina for written exams. Lectures, papers and tests come more easily to them than to most. Prior study, not mastery: specialist academy work still takes effort, and book learning says little about people. Not a license: grades open doors but promise nothing, and a scholarship can be lost. It shows in neat notes, a study schedule and classmates who ask to borrow their notes.
